notes.title: Whistle Willie Announced!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685059/bd52d36ba3050a6aca087bc2eb3d67ac29ad3b40.png"][/img][/p][h2]Whistle Willie has been announced! ːsteamhappyː[/h2][p][/p][p]Here at Spelkollektivet in Sweden, we are excited to share with you all this special project of ours. There is a lot we want to talk about, but we need to save some stuff for later. ːsteammockingː However, if you're curious for a bit more info, make sure to read the Bloody Disgusting article on Whistle Willie.
